# LTCme.click

> A non-custodial Litecoin web wallet with an AI assistant, wallet tools, and a transaction builder.

LTCme.click lets users import or generate Litecoin wallets, view balances, send and receive LTC, and chat with a Litecoin-focused AI. The app requires Google sign-in to access wallet features. Most tools are free; the AI assistant offers 5 free messages, then paid plans.

## Pages

- [Pricing](/pricing): Subscription plans for the Litecoin AI assistant.
